newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures settle weaker, May breakes support.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures settle weaker, May breakes support.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures closed at the lows and under key support on a late-session bout of speculative and fund selling, market sources said.
"As anticipated, we are continuing a downtrend. Look for the market to retest the old (contract) low of 77.50," an analyst said.
Weak technicals and an ongoing bearish fundamental outlook has kept the market under pressure. Today's selling accelerated once spot May fell below 80.00 cents and ran into light stops.
Activity was brisk ahead of the long Easter weekend. Volume was estimated at 6,000 lots compared to Wednesday's official 3,019 lots.
The NYCE will be closed for Good Friday.
The May contract closed at 79.45 cents, down 2.35, having ranged from 82.70 to 79.20 cents. The back months settled 2.50 lower to 0.10 firmer.
Second-position July and the deferred September contract fell to life-of-contract lows of 81.25 cents and 84.00 cents, respectively.

The FCOJ weekly movement figure released later today could set the stage for additional losses next week, if the number falls below five million gallons, analysts said. A movement above five million gallons could be supportive to prices.
